messages.content:
Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement. Format the outputs in JSON.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input
input: {
    "question": "user: IBM Cloud platform\nassistant: The IBM Cloud platform is a comprehensive solution that combines platform as a service (PaaS) and infrastructure as a service (IaaS) to provide an integrated experience. It is designed to support both small development teams and large enterprise businesses, with solutions available for working in the public cloud, on-premises, or a combination. The platform is built to support your needs whether it's working only in the public cloud or taking advantage of a multicloud deployment model. It consists of a network of interrelated components that work together to provide a consistent and dependable cloud experience to support your app development needs. These components include a robust console, an identity and access management component, a catalog of hundreds of supported products, and a search and tagging mechanism for filtering and identifying your resources.\nuser: its applications \nassistant: The IBM Cloud platform supports various types of applications, ranging from traditional monolithic applications to modern cloud-native applications. The platform's open architecture allows you to develop apps once and deploy them anywhere, ensuring workload portability. Whether you need to migrate apps to the cloud, modernize your existing apps by using cloud services, ensure data resiliency against regional failure, or use new paradigms and deployment topologies to innovate and build your cloud-native apps, the IBM Cloud platform is designed to accommodate your use case.\n\n\nuser: About its services\nassistant: The IBM Cloud platform offers a wide range of services that cater to different needs. These services include platform services like account management, catalogs, cloud shell, console, global search and tagging, and IAM, which are all globally available and highly available. Each platform service has a Service Level Agreement (SLA) of 99.99% availability. Additionally, IBM Cloud provides infrastructure services, AI and machine learning services, data and analytics services, security services, and many more.All IBM Cloud platform services that support service keys can be integrated by using Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud service binding.\nuser: Fees ?\nassistant: \nFor IBM Cloud Satellite, there are no charges for hosts that are attached to a location but not assigned to a resource. You can have as many hosts waiting in your location without being charged for future growth. You are only charged for the underlying infrastructure that you bring to Satellite, which might have its own charges.\nFor the IBM Cloud push service, there are two components to pricing: a destination instance fee and a consumption price. A pre-production destination instance fee is charged monthly for every pre-production destination added to your Event Notifications instance. Consumption is based on outbound digital messages, with 500 devices or 5000 outbound digital messages permitted per pre-production destination. If either the number of devices or the number of outbound digital messages exceeds the permitted limit, the permitted number is moved by additional 500 devices or by additional 5\nuser: Is the data is safe? How do I know?",
    "answer": "文档没有提供足够信息来判断数据是否安全。它建议参阅 IBM Cloud 关于数据安全的说明；其中提到 Security and Compliance Center 会通过内部服务间授权收集目标环境的资源配置信息，以评估账户合规性。[S1][S2][S4]"
}
Output:

statements: 文档没有提供足够信息来判断 IBM Cloud 平台上的数据是否安全。
文档建议参阅 IBM Cloud 关于数据安全的说明。
IBM Cloud 关于数据安全的说明提到，Security and Compliance Center 会通过内部服务间授权收集目标环境的资源配置信息。
Security and Compliance Center 收集目标环境的资源配置信息的目的是评估账户合规性。
